content.text: {"core": "Transformation ends what has finished so something else can begin — it works by closing the form a thing was using, not by destroying the thing. In Breakthrough, that closing goes unnoticed: the old shape keeps standing past its end, still treated as the living structure, and Breakthrough finds nothing it is permitted to remove. The clearing cannot clear.", "sheetLine": "The old shape still stands; nothing here is permitted to end."}
